source_page_metadata.description: Explore the Snow White marijuana strain - THC levels, genetics, terpene profile, effects, flavor, and grow tips.

article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Indica-Dominant Hybrid
Genetics: Northern Lights × White Widow
Breeder: Nirvana Seeds
THC Content: 18–23%
CBD Content: Low (typically under 1%)
Terpene Profile: Myrcene , Pinene , Caryophyllene
Primary Flavors: Earthy, Sweet, Herbal, Slightly Citrus
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–9 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: Late September to Early October
Indoor Yield: 16–20 oz per m²
Outdoor Yield: 18–22 oz per plant
Grow Difficulty: Easy to Moderate

Snow White is a classic hybrid that emerged from the Dutch breeding scene during the rise of stabilized cannabis genetics in the 1990s. Developed by Nirvana Seeds, the strain represents a thoughtful blend of two legendary parent lines—Northern Lights and White Widow. By combining these iconic genetics, breeders created a cultivar that captures the heavy resin production of the “White” family while maintaining the sturdy growth characteristics associated with Northern Lights.

The result is a plant that appeals to both growers and consumers. Cultivators appreciate its manageable growth structure and reliable yields, while enthusiasts value the dense, crystal-covered buds and balanced effects. With its combination of calming physical relaxation and gentle mental uplift, this hybrid continues to hold a respected place among classic cannabis strains .
Genetics and Lineage

The lineage of Snow White draws from two foundational cannabis families that helped define modern hybrid breeding. One parent, Northern Lights , is widely regarded as one of the most influential indica strains ever developed. Originating from Afghani landrace genetics, Northern Lights introduced compact plant structure, rapid flowering cycles, and powerful relaxing effects to countless hybrid strains .

Northern Lights also contributed exceptional resin production and environmental resilience. These traits made it particularly valuable for breeders seeking plants that could perform reliably in indoor cultivation environments. Within this hybrid, the Northern Lights influence provides stability, dense bud formation, and deeply soothing body effects.

The second parent, White Widow , became famous during the 1990s after its introduction by Dutch breeders. This strain gained worldwide attention for its extraordinary trichome coverage, giving the buds a frosty white appearance that inspired the “White” family of cannabis strains . White Widow also introduced balanced hybrid effects that combine mild cerebral stimulation with relaxing body sensations.

By crossing Northern Lights with White Widow, Nirvana Seeds produced a plant that inherited both heavy resin production and structural stability. The resulting cultivar displays strong hybrid vigor and a terpene profile that blends earthy spice with subtle sweetness.
Effects and Experience

The experience produced by this hybrid typically begins with a subtle mental shift that encourages calm awareness. Shortly after consumption, many individuals notice a gentle sense of mood elevation accompanied by a relaxed mental state. Rather than producing overwhelming stimulation, the strain tends to create a steady feeling of comfort and ease.

As the effects deepen, a noticeable wave of physical relaxation begins to spread throughout the body. Muscular tension often fades as the body settles into a tranquil state. Despite this relaxing quality, the mental effects usually remain clear enough to allow conversation and social interaction.

Over time, the experience often transitions into a balanced state of calm. The body remains relaxed while the mind stays lightly engaged, making the hybrid suitable for evenings or quiet social gatherings. In larger amounts, the relaxing qualities may become more pronounced, encouraging rest and introspection.
Medical Benefits

The calming body effects associated with this cultivar have made it appealing for individuals dealing with physical tension or chronic discomfort. The combination of cannabinoids and relaxing terpenes may help ease muscular tightness and reduce stress-related physical strain.

The hybrid’s mild mental uplift can also assist individuals experiencing emotional fatigue or anxiety . By promoting relaxation without intense psychoactive stimulation, the strain may help create a more balanced mental state.

Additionally, the relaxing properties of the plant may support sleep preparation. As the effects progress, the body often settles into a comfortable state that encourages rest. Many mmj patients exploring cannabis for nighttime use find that this balanced progression helps them unwind before sleep.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

The aromatic profile of Snow White reflects its diverse genetic heritage. When the dried flower is broken apart, earthy herbal notes typically dominate the scent. These deeper tones are often accompanied by subtle hints of pine and spice that add complexity to the fragrance.

Myrcene contributes an earthy foundation to the aroma, while caryophyllene introduces a peppery warmth. Pinene adds a crisp forest-like note that balances the heavier elements and gives the scent a fresh character.

During consumption, the flavor tends to mirror the aromatic profile while introducing additional layers of nuance. The inhale often carries herbal earthiness accompanied by faint sweetness. As the vapor or smoke lingers on the palate, hints of spice and pine emerge, creating a smooth and balanced flavor experience.
Growing Information

Cultivators often appreciate this hybrid for its manageable growth habits and strong resilience. The plant typically develops a medium height with sturdy branches capable of supporting dense buds. Its Northern Lights heritage helps maintain a compact structure that performs well in indoor growing environments.

Indoor flowering cycles usually complete within eight to nine weeks. During this stage, the plant produces thick clusters of flowers coated in shimmering trichomes. The heavy resin production inherited from White Widow often gives the buds a frosty appearance.

Outdoor cultivation can produce excellent results in temperate climates with consistent sunlight. When grown outdoors, the plant may develop slightly larger structures while maintaining dense bud formation. Proper airflow and moderate humidity levels help ensure healthy growth throughout the flowering period.
FAQ
What kind of strain is Snow White? Snow White is an indica-dominant hybrid created by crossing Northern Lights with White Widow.
How strong is Snow White? THC levels typically range between 18% and 22%, providing moderate potency compared to many modern hybrids.
What does Snow White taste like? The flavor often includes earthy herbal notes combined with subtle pine, spice, and faint sweetness.
Is Snow White good for nighttime use? Many consumers prefer it during the evening because of its relaxing body effects and calming mental qualities.
Is Snow White easy to grow? Yes. The plant is generally considered beginner-friendly due to its compact structure, stable genetics, and relatively short flowering time.
Final Thoughts on Snow White

Snow White represents a thoughtful fusion of two legendary cannabis families. By combining the structural reliability of Northern Lights with the heavy resin production of White Widow, Nirvana Seeds created a hybrid capable of delivering both strong performance in the garden and enjoyable effects for consumers.

Its balanced terpene profile and moderate potency make it approachable while still offering the depth and complexity appreciated by experienced enthusiasts. The dense, frosty buds reflect the genetic heritage that gave the “White” family its reputation for exceptional trichome coverage. For growers and consumers seeking a classic hybrid with dependable genetics and relaxing effects, Snow White continues to stand as a respected member of the broader Northern Lights and White Widow lineage.
